## 19c55a8731b1

**Reproduced test-infrastructure defect; no semantic generator counterexample found.** Audited generator SHA-256: `c3eacb09b0f60714f9f8140e9c724d9c5d420267919b2d0a9685316f9071e4d1`; test SHA-256: `f51613e3647efd78ee862a3b9c004e6b5ad16c675ff4ee156c218b0a3357dc43`.

The task-local suite computes canonical data as `Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl"`. In the official portable runtime that resolves under `generators/19c55a8731b1/`, where the file does not exist, so preflight fails and none of the substantive tests execute. Use `reviewer_support.find_root(__file__)`, `canonical_path`, and `canonical_pairs` instead.

Evidence: `checks/audit/19c55a8731b1-task-tests/result.json` and `checks/audit/19c55a8731b1/repro.json`. As a separate semantic check, `checks/audit/19c55a8731b1/repro.py` scanned 960 generated scenes (3 bands × 4 profiles × 80 seeds) and found no failure in `self_check`, exact profile observation, or the rule mirror changing exactly the intended gray cells. That finite scan is not approval; it only means the actionable finding here is the nonportable test path.
